text:
alejandro: Heads up — ran into a weird parity failure across SDKs when running the sampleapp on the embeddings + rerank flow. Go/Rust clients are seeing shape/order differences vs Python. Repro steps in the app, minimal trace below.

mira: Can you paste the raw responses? quick check first: dim mismatch vs field name mismatch?

alejandro: Paste of two responses (trimmed):
```json
// python-sdk (what we expect)
{
  "data": [ { "index": 0, "embedding": [0.00123, -0.2345, ...] } ],
  "model": "redwood-embed-v1"
}
// go-sdk (observed)
{
  "vectors": [ [0.0012299999, -0.23450001, ...] ],
  "meta": { "count": 1 }
}
```
Also rerank reply: python returns `{"scores": [{"index":0, "score":0.87}]}` but go returns `{"ranking": [{"i":0, "s":0.8721}]`.

mira: Ugh. So two problems: envelope keys differ (data vs vectors) and rerank field naming. That'll break the sampleapp's postprocessing. Any sign it's batching-related or earlier in the stack?

sam: From a quick grep, the Go/Rust embed helpers use the legacy transport wrapper that maps the response into a compact `vectors` array to save bytes. That wrapper also does a trim/pad step for batching which can reorder padding at the end. If retries happen mid-batch, the mapping index -> original position can shift. Could be an idempotency/retry edge.

katie: We're also seeing concurrent auth refresh flows in the SDKs: multiple goroutines do a refresh, one 401 triggers a retry while the other continues to send partial batches. That creates duplicate partial batches and makes index mapping flaky. :thinking_face: We should gate refresh so only one in-flight refresh occurs.

devkit-bot: Deploy succeeded: embed-batcher-shim canary -> prod (2023-04-04T12:34:56Z) :rocket:

alejandro: Nice. For a short-term fix I can change the sampleapp to accept both envelopes, but we should align SDK outputs to a canonical envelope: `embeddings: [{index, embedding}]` and `rerank: [{index, score}]`. Also standardize float precision to 32-bit to avoid tiny diffs.

mira: I'll add a normalization shim in devex/embed-helper that converts `vectors` -> `data` and maps `ranking.i/s` -> `index/score`. Will add unit tests for batch-padding and a synthetic retry scenario.

sam: PR prepped: https://github.com/redwood/sampleapp/pull/687 — branch `devex/embed-normalize`. Includes test harness for idempotent batch replay and a utility `reconstructIndices(padMask, originalOrder)`.

katie: Who's owning the SDK change? I can do the Go side gate for auth refresh. Assigning mira for normalization + tests and sam for sampleapp + rerank mapping. @alejandro can you do a quick sampleapp patch to accept both envelopes so onboarding isn't blocked?

alejandro: Yep — will open a tiny compat PR this afternoon. Also logging note: add a warn when incoming embedding len != expected_dim: `if len(embedding) != config.dim: log.Warn(...)` to fail fast on silent shape swaps.

mira: Sounds good. I'll loop in platform-team to consider a schema-version header like `X-Redwood-Schema: 1` so we can do graceful upgrades.

sam: Quick test matrix I'll run: Go/Rust/Py clients x 1/4/16 batch sizes x auth refresh vs normal x simulated retry. Will post results here.

katie: Thanks team — file followups as issues if you hit anything odd. :thumbsup:
